content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the kernel storing vector registers into the area allocated for floating-point registers when vector register support was disabled for a guest. This resulted in memory overwrites, as the guest_fpregs structure was not designed to accommodate vector register data, leading to corruption of memory and unpredictable behavior. The patch resolves this by consolidating the storage for vector and floating-point registers into a single structure, ensuring proper data conversion and preventing overwrites.
